name: Physical Stock Units
dax: CALCULATE(SUM('fact stock position'[stock_units]), 'fact stock position'[stock_derived] = FALSE())
description: Stock that is physically on the shelf.
note: Derived bundle stock is excluded: the parts are already counted.

name: Derived Bundle Units
dax: CALCULATE(SUM('fact stock position'[stock_units]), 'fact stock position'[stock_derived] = TRUE())
description: Bundles that could be built from the parts in stock.
note: Never add to Physical Stock Units: it is the same stock, seen twice.

name: Products At Risk
dax: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('fact stock position'), 'fact stock position'[risk] IN {"critical", "warning"})
note: Risk comes from the live forecast; unknown is never counted as risk.

name: Units To Order
description: Units the engine proposes to reorder.
note: A proposal, not an order. A human approves every line.

name: Order Value EUR
description: What the proposed reorder is worth.
note: Blank where the purchase price is unknown.

name: Stock Value EUR
description: The value of the stock on the shelf.
note: Needs a purchase price per article; see the master template.

name: Average Cover Months
description: Average months of cover across the assortment.
note: Blank rows (unknown demand) are excluded by AVERAGE.

name: Data Completeness %
dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('fact stock position'), 'fact stock position'[completeness] = "complete"), COUNTROWS('fact stock position'))
description: How much of the assortment the run could actually measure.

name: Reconciliation Agreement %
description: How often the typed figure equals the live figure.
note: Bundle rows have their own verdict: they are not comparable.

name: Missing Supplier %
dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('dim product'), 'dim product'[missing_supplier] = TRUE()), COUNTROWS('dim product'))
description: Share of products without a supplier - the Step 1 gap.

name: Missing Purchase Price %
dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('dim product'), 'dim product'[missing_price] = TRUE()), COUNTROWS('dim product'))
description: Share of products without a purchase price.

name: Bundles
description: How many bundle articles the assortment holds.
